scenario.description: Security groups are virtual firewalls attached to EC2 instances and other AWS resources. A rule allowing inbound traffic from 0.0.0.0/0 (the entire internet) on port 22 (SSH) or port 3389 (RDP) exposes the instance to brute-force attacks, credential stuffing, and exploitation of any SSH/RDP vulnerabilities — from anyone on the internet, at all times. These management ports should only be reachable from trusted IPs (e.g., a VPN or bastion host). the agent should identify security groups with unrestricted inbound rules on management ports.
